<style>

.name-link {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.name-link:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
  color: #007BFF;
}

.social-links {
        text-align: center;
        margin-top: 20px;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 10px;
        align-items: center;
}

.social-links a {
        display: inline-block;
}

.social-links img {
        width: 40px;
        height: auto;
        transition: transform 0.2s;
}

.social-links img:hover {
        transform: scale(1.1);
}

.timeline-section {
  border-left: 4px solid #007BFF;
  margin-left: 20px;
  padding-left: 20px;
  position: relative;
}

.timeline-part {
  padding: 30px 20px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.timeline-heading {
  font-size: 1.5em;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  color: #007BFF;
}

.timeline-item {
  margin-bottom: 30px;
  position: relative;
}

.timeline-item::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: -49px;
  top: 5px;
  width: 15px;
  height: 15px;
  background: #007BFF;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.timeline-date {
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #007BFF;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.timeline-content h4 {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.experience-bg {
  background-color: #f7faff; /* light blueish */
}

.education-bg {
  background-color: #fef8f3; /* light orange/cream */
}

.header-flex {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
  gap: 30px;
}

.header-left {
  flex: 0 0 140px;
}

.profile-pic {
  width: 140px;
  height: 140px;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.header-right {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 220px;
}

.header-right h1 {
  margin-top: 0;
  font-size: 1.8em;
}

.header-right h4 {
  margin-bottom: 0.5em;
  font-weight: normal;
  color: #444;
}

.header-right a {
  color: #007BFF;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.header-right a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}


ul {
    list-style-type: square;
    padding-left: 16px;
}

li { padding: 4px 0px; }

hr {
    border: 0 none;
    height: 3px;
    color: #1c1c1c;

}

}
